subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Foul smell will come if the food is __not fresh__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**stale**" refers to something that has lost its freshness, especially food, and has developed an unpleasant taste or smell. (बासी)

 
 
• **Example:** The bread had become stale after being left out overnight.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 3**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Brittle"** refers to something that is easily broken, not suitable for describing food that has gone bad due to being stale. (नाजुक)

 
 
• **Example:** The brittle ice shattered when stepped on.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Crisp"** implies something is fresh and crunchy, which does not fit the description of food that is stale and smells bad. (खस्ता)
 
 
• **Example:** The crisp apple was delicious and juicy.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "Odourless"** refers to something with no smell, which is the opposite of food that is stale and has a foul odor. (बिना गंध के)
 
 
• **Example:** The odourless air purifier is perfect for any room.
